name: kpost-testbench-v2
description: KPost test bench automation framework built on Playwright + TypeScript

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.kpost: cross-env VALIDATION_PROFILE=FULL BUGZILLA_DRY_RUN=true TEST_DB_MODE=true MOCK_API=false OTP_TEST_GATEWAY=true KATCHUP_LIFECYCLE=true KALL_LIFECYCLE=true PROFILE_LIFECYCLE=true CONTACTS_LIFECYCLE=true GROUP_LIFECYCLE=true SETTINGS_LIFECYCLE=true KDIARY_LIFECYCLE=true KOS_LIFECYCLE=true AWS_LIFECYCLE=true playwright test --project=api --grep @kpost-api --workers=1
